papers.title: CNet: A Complex-Valued Deep Learning Framework with Wirtinger Autodifferentiation and FFT--Hadamard Convolution
findings: Section11 pp11-12 and Fig2 p14 explicitly define squared complex inner-product causal attention and complex value pooling.
The attention epsilon is denominator-only; described runs use zero. Section5 p6 defines TokenNorm as RMS pre-normalization, not an assurance of unit-norm projected Q/K.
Language-model performance, finite-difference accuracy and author priority statements are source claims, not reproduced outcomes or accepted priority here.
limits: Selected equations/architecture passages, not full numerical/complexity/gradient-proof reproduction.
Current repository commit10Nov2026 is separately pinned; not certified as the paper experiment revision.
No C++/CUDA compile, upstream tests or GPU runs; p6 formula inspected as text, not a rendered page.
